title: Molecular reactivity and product formation in light-driven N-cyclopropyl tetrahydropyridine oxidation
difficulty_reasons: Requires a connected molecular account across oxidation accessibility, substituent/stereochemical ring fate, isomerization and isotope-compatible products.
Agent-chosen models and informative tests must be actually executed and validated, with environment/method limits and competing interpretations separated from observations.

paper.title: A Biomimetic Study of the Behavior of N-Cyclopropyl-Based Single Electron Transfer Probes in the Context of Monoamine Oxidase-Catalyzed Oxidations

data.description: Neutral scientific question, graph-explicit starting identities/stereochemistry and isotope sites, reaction/comparator context and qualitative observations.

required_deliverables.description: Structured hypotheses, actual investigations, evidence, conclusions, execution/resolution statuses, limitations and artifact index following the shared schema.
